label: ProductLaunchVendorCompliance process: Validate Bill of Materials Compliance — Ensure all product components meet engineering standards and regulatory requirements before manufacturing begins.

trace.picked_reason: Best match for ProductLaunchVendorCompliance process. This agent directly validates bill-of-materials compliance against both engineering standards and regulatory requirements.
